title: the whole game is free, i just want feedback
author: naveed_qasim56
selftext:
The Host’s Table is free. All five tables, every boss, the Unsated and the ending, right here in your browser. The Mac and Windows downloads are free too.

[https://naveedqasim.itch.io/hosts-table](https://naveedqasim.itch.io/hosts-table)

This is my first game, and right now I care more about people playing it than about sales. If you enjoy it, the tip jar is there, but please don’t feel you have to.

*^(\*full disclosure: i’m a designer, not an artist or a coder, though i’ve worked on games throughout my career. i used ai tools to help build this, but the design and every decision in it are mine.)*
